displayIdentity.body: Paul asks Corinth to bear a jealous foolishness. I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me. But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
displayIdentity.title: Paul asks Corinth to bear a jealous foolishness
